note: Real, append-only actual-cost ledger for every PAID/UNKNOWN_COST Worker/Adapter execution that actually completed (owner, 2026-08-09, Constitution Rule 257 — Execution Plane Cost Gate, TASK-048/FCR-009). Written ONLY by app/api/admin/ide/_lib/costGateRuntime.ts#recordActualCost(), called from codeWorkerRuntime.ts immediately after a real Adapter.execute() call returns a real cost.kind==='ACTUAL' result. Starts empty in this build: the real, historical FCR-009 incident (~$0.29-0.58 USD, TASK-047, registry/worker01-sandbox/live-proof.txt) predates this ledger and remains documented only in registry/FACTORY_CENTRAL_REGISTRY.json/registry/CONSTITUTION.json Rule 257 — both explicitly off-limits to this build (TASK-048's own constraint) — never backfilled here with a re-derived or fabricated number.
schema_note: entries[] is real and append-only — per Rule 257 clause 12 (no retroactive editing of past test/cost results), an entry is NEVER edited or removed after being written, only ever appended to. Each entry: entry_id (uuid), task_id, worker_id (real Adapter id, e.g. claude-cli), provider, model, estimated_cost (the real pre-call estimate that was gated), actual_cost (the real, post-call reported cost — null if the Adapter genuinely could not report one), currency, timestamp (ISO8601, when recorded), approval_reference (either a real costGateRuntime.ts decisionId for a zero-cost/budget-covered RELEASE, or a real budget_id string for a pre-approved-budget RELEASE — never fabricated).
